event.description: Reduce FF width to 16 with block-diagonal output mixing
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; retained incumbent is 3200 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0021 MQA+ff17 at 3584/99.17%; same-family failed result: attempt-0022 MQA+ff16 with full output projection at 3520/98.50%; prior attempts in this family: 9. The latest accepted attempt-0030 changed attention output organization to per-head block-diagonal projections and reached 3200/100%, so this proposal tests ff16 in that new context rather than repeating the prior near miss. Hypothesis: the structured output mixer preserves enough specialization to allow ff16, yielding 3136 parameters. Keep affine-free block pre-norms, full final norm, learned positions, mixed-digit training, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3200 parameters.
